review_notes: Read the whole target file and checked uses of the referenceSelf_* lemmas and physicalFrozenCenteredCoefficient_eq_zero across the repo (Grep). I also checked the referenceOriginalLabel and referenceFamily_physicalPacket declarations. None of the referenceSelf_* lemmas has a @[simp] attribute. Each is applied only through `rw` with the full explicit argument list `t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency`. I did not inspect the definitions of `snappedSite` or `positiveEnvelope` in detail. I cannot run Lean, so I don't know whether simp would unify the dependent `(Q).labels j` binder types, or whether the proof arguments of `referenceFamily` unify. The proposals are therefore framed as targeted simp lemmas whose behaviour needs checking. They are not claimed to compile. Nothing in the file looks like a loop. The hypothesis-carrying lemma physicalFrozenCenteredCoefficient_eq_zero is rightly not a simp lemma.

findings.excerpt:
theorem referenceSelf_snappedSite (j : Fin N) (l : (Q).labels j) (u : Item j l) :
    (Q).snappedSite j l u = P.snappedSite j (orig j l) u := by
findings.problem: These lemmas rewrite a quantity of the self-reference family `Q` back to the original lattice `P` at `orig j l`. That is the canonical normal form, since `orig` is the only way to compare the two families. None is tagged `@[simp]`. Every use, at lines 107-108 and 172-173 and in the proof of `referenceSelf_positiveEnvelope` at line 55, is a `rw` that spells out the whole parameter list `t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency`. Several proofs also need manual `change`/`unfold` steps to expose the `Q` structure: line 46 `change snappedLatticeSite ... = _` followed by `simp only [sub_self,zero_mul,add_zero]`, and line 64 `change ((↑(P.length j*P.width):ℂ)⁻¹)*...`. The explicit-argument `rw` style makes every call site brittle: the hypotheses `hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency` are only proofs and are irrelevant to the rewrite. It also means a `simp` call cannot normalise `Q`-expressions on its own.
findings.proposed_change: Mark `referenceSelf_snappedSite`, `referenceSelf_positiveEnvelope`, `referenceSelf_frozenCenteredCoefficient` and `referenceSelf_alt_physicalPacket` as `@[simp]`. All four have LHS head `(Q).…` and RHS in terms of `P` and `orig j l`, so the direction is terminating and `P`-normalising. If simp turns out to have trouble with the dependent `(Q).labels j` binders, state them with the proof arguments implicit/instance-like or keep them as `simp` lemmas only inside a local `simp only [...]` set. Then the `rw [P.referenceSelf_… t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency, …]` blocks in `physicalMainScale_eq_narrow_reference` and `physicalCenteredMaskedBand_eq_narrow_reference` can become `simp only [referenceSelf_frozenCenteredCoefficient, referenceSelf_positiveEnvelope]`. Check that this compiles; I have not tested it.
findings.benefit: Call sites no longer repeat ten explicit arguments. Proofs about `Q` reduce to `P` by simp, so a family of restriction lemmas shares one rewrite set. The proof of `referenceSelf_positiveEnvelope` also shrinks, because its `rw` is replaced by simp.

evidence.excerpt: rw [P.referenceSelf_frozenCenteredCoefficient t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency,
rw [P.referenceSelf_snappedSite t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency]
P.referenceSelf_alt_physicalPacket t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency]

findings.problem: `referenceSelf_absoluteConstant` is a definitional equation that normalises `(Q).absoluteConstant` to `P.absoluteConstant`. `referenceSelf_constant` computes the `constant` of `Q` as `P.absoluteConstant*(F*cone+2)`. Neither has a simp attribute, and neither is used anywhere in the repo except `referenceSelf_constant`, which the narrow-tail file applies by `rw` with the full explicit argument list. `referenceSelf_absoluteConstant` has no use outside its own declaration. So any later goal that mentions `(Q).constant` or `(Q).absoluteConstant` is left to manual `unfold`/`rw` steps.
findings.proposed_change: Add `@[simp]` to `referenceSelf_absoluteConstant`. Its LHS head is `absoluteConstant (referenceFamily ...)` and it rewrites to the original `P`, so it cannot loop. Consider `@[simp]` on `referenceSelf_constant` too, since its RHS contains only `P.absoluteConstant`, `F` and `cone`. Alternatively state that lemma with the shared parameters implicit so `rw [referenceSelf_constant]` suffices. Otherwise delete `referenceSelf_absoluteConstant` if no rewrite uses it.
findings.benefit: Constants of the narrow family normalise to constants of `P` in one step, and call sites such as the two in `SourceLabeledNarrowTail` no longer need all ten explicit arguments. If the lemma is deleted instead, the unused API shrinks.

evidence.excerpt: rw [P.referenceSelf_constant t R cone w F hw hcone hF hwide hfrequency]
